lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in distinctive vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a grid-like array across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of pale pixel intensity align with and intersect the columns of circular blobs, creating a series of nodes within a visible rectangular grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear ridges extending horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance highlight on the dorsal aspect and a pronounced shadow gradient on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance spots visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, concentrated primarily at the base and mid-section.
